# Atlas Tasker

> The ticketing system for you and your AI agents: terminal tickets, a local web kanban board, and MCP tools, all in one binary.

Atlas Tasker is a free, MIT-licensed, local-first issue tracker for macOS and Linux. Tickets are Markdown files in your repository, every change is an audited event, and humans and coding agents share queues, dependencies, runs, evidence, gates, and handoffs. Lightweight by design: no server, no account, no daemon.

Install with `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/myrrazor/atlas-tasker/main/scripts/install.sh | sh`.

## Guidance for agents
Use this file as a site index, not a full-site corpus. To operate Atlas Tasker on a user's machine, prefer the CLI with `--json` and run `tracker --help` for the current command set; exit codes 0-7 and `error.code` values are stable. Use `tracker mcp serve` when a tool-native MCP connection is available, starting with `--tool-profile read` for inspection or `--tool-profile workflow` for authorized ticket work, and pin `--workspace`. Repository guidance from `tracker integrations install` and MCP client registration are separate steps. Never mutate tickets without the actor and reason fields required by the tool or command, and do not scrape the local web board; it is for humans.
